title: pattern-picker template variables
description: Values for templates/pattern-picker.md.j2 and templates/pattern-picker.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from pattern-picker.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

design_owner.title: Design owner
design_owner.description: Which designer owns this pattern set? The person a reviewer argues with about a mandatory pattern marked optional - often not the feature's engineering owner.

feature_name.description: Which feature is being classified? Use the name the brief and the eval set already use, so the picker result can be traced back to the feature it was decided for.

irreversible.title: Irreversible
irreversible.description: Can an action this feature takes be undone by the user afterwards? If not, the undo gate is mandatory and the confirmation must name what is about to be lost.

last_reviewed_date.description: When was this picker last rerun against the feature, as YYYY-MM-DD? The three axes change as a feature grows, and a stale picker hides a pattern that became mandatory.

p1_component.title: P1 component
p1_component.description: Which existing component implements the confidence_indicator? Name one from the design system, or say 'new' and expect a design review.

p1_mand.title: P1 mand
p1_mand.description: Is the confidence_indicator pattern mandatory here? It is whenever the output can be wrong in a way the user cannot see for themselves.

p1_surface.title: P1 surface
p1_surface.description: Where does the confidence_indicator appear - beside the output, in a hover, in a sidebar? Name the place a user's eye lands, not the component tree.

p2_component.title: P2 component
p2_component.description: Which component renders the refusal? Name one from the design system, or say 'new'.

p2_mand.title: P2 mand
p2_mand.description: Is the refusal_surface pattern mandatory here? It is whenever refusal_possible is yes.

p2_surface.title: P2 surface
p2_surface.description: Where does a refusal appear, and what does the user see instead of the result they asked for?

p3_component.title: P3 component
p3_component.description: Which component carries the edit handoff? Name one from the design system, or say 'new'.

p3_mand.title: P3 mand
p3_mand.description: Is the edit_handoff pattern mandatory here? It is whenever the user is expected to correct the output rather than accept or discard it whole.

p3_surface.title: P3 surface
p3_surface.description: Where does the user take over the output and start editing it?

p4_component.title: P4 component
p4_component.description: Which component shows the why trail? Name one from the design system, or say 'new'.

p4_mand.title: P4 mand
p4_mand.description: Is the why_trail pattern mandatory here? It is whenever the user has to justify the output to somebody else - a reviewer, a customer, an auditor.

p4_surface.title: P4 surface
p4_surface.description: Where does the user find out why the system produced this output?

p5_component.title: P5 component
p5_component.description: Which component implements the undo gate? Name one from the design system, or say 'new'.

p5_mand.title: P5 mand
p5_mand.description: Is the undo_gate pattern mandatory here? It is whenever irreversible is yes.

p5_surface.title: P5 surface
p5_surface.description: Where does the undo gate stand - before the action, after it, or both?

p6_component.title: P6 component
p6_component.description: Which component implements progressive_disclosure? Write 'n/a' when the pattern is not used here.

p6_surface.title: P6 surface
p6_surface.description: If progressive_disclosure is used, where is the detail hidden and what reveals it? Write 'n/a' when the pattern is not used here.

p7_component.title: P7 component
p7_component.description: Which component implements batch_operations? Write 'n/a' when the pattern is not used here.

p7_surface.title: P7 surface
p7_surface.description: If batch_operations are offered, where does the user select a set and act on it? Write 'n/a' when the pattern is not used here.

refusal_possible.title: Refusal possible
refusal_possible.description: Can this feature refuse or return nothing at all? If it can, a refusal surface is mandatory - an unexplained empty result reads as a broken product.

ui_surface.title: Ui surface
ui_surface.description: Where does this feature meet the user - inline in an editor, a chat panel, a batch job with no UI at all? The surface decides which patterns are even implementable.
